verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the CDP CLI is configured with an API key and wallet secret, but nothing documents scoping those credentials or issuing least-privilege keys for an agent. Agentic Wallet spending caps, per-payment max amounts and onchain spend permissions are adjacent spending controls, not scoped API credentials, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
